# First path segments of the NocoBase 2 documentation that docs.nocobase.com permanently redirects (301) to the same
# path on https://nocode.docs.nocobase.com, one per line. Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored.
#
# This list must stay identical to the regular expression of the EdgeScript rule `v2_paths_to_nocode_301` on the
# docs.nocobase.com CDN. Change one and you must change the other in the same delivery.
#
# check-v2-redirect-prefixes.mjs fails `Docs build` when the v3 build output has a top-level entry with one of these
# names, because the CDN would redirect every page under it to the v2 documentation before it reaches the bucket.
